name: Foggy MacKreel
summary: On the broken Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel is stranded above a dizzying drop with a moonshine delivery bound for Southshore on his mind.

sections.title: Stranded on the Span
sections.body: Foggy MacKreel waits on broken pylons beneath the Thandol Span, calm on his dangerous perch. Dark Iron sabotage and war damage shattered the bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. Rescue can wait; MacKreel wants his potent moonshine delivered to the patrons of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. So he hires passing travelers nimble enough to reach his ledge and finish the delivery.

faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel is a dwarf courier stranded on ruined stone pillars beneath the broken Thandol Span. The drop does not trouble him; he is focused on delivering his moonshine.

faq.q: Where can I find Foggy MacKreel?
faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel waits on a stone platform midway down the broken central span of the Thandol Span. Carefully jump down from the bridge structure on the Arathi Highlands side to reach him.

faq.q: Why is Foggy MacKreel down there?
aliases: why is he on the bridge
faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel became stuck in the Thandol Span wreckage during his travels. His chief concern is finding someone to carry his moonshine the rest of the way to Southshore.

faq.q: What quest does Foggy MacKreel offer?
faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel offers MacKreel's Moonshine and asks travelers to carry a jug of his potent brew to the tavern in Southshore, across the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may know MacKreel's stubborn grit and peculiar priorities. He cares more about delivering strong liquor on time than being stranded over a fatal chasm.
As an Alliance courier traveling between Ironforge and Southshore, you may cross paths with Foggy and carry his stranded cargo for a fellow subject of the Alliance.
